decision: Clean, dependency-free Node implementation instead of extending the reference Next.js repository
why: The reference runtime depends on the OpenAI Realtime voice API, Google OAuth and a large surface (560 source files) that cannot run or be tested here without credentials. A small text-first system can be fully tested end to end while preserving the paper's commitments. The reference repository was audited and its concepts reused (intake agent, design document, template prompts, mentor/practice/feedback, journal/evidence).
reversible: Yes: the experience package is a declarative JSON that could be exported to the reference repository's experience.json format.

decision: Pedagogy decisions (evidence, adaptation, phase gating, feedback) are deterministic and rule-based; a model provider only voices character moves
why: Makes approval meaningful (an approved design fully determines runtime behavior), allows deterministic replay, and prevents goal drift, over-helping and invented evidence by construction. It also lets the system run without credentials.
reversible: Partially: provider hooks exist for voicing and revision parsing; evidence classification by a model could be added behind the same guard.

decision: Text chat instead of real-time voice
why: There are no voice credentials, and text is accessible and testable. Voice is the reference repository's modality, not a Primer Contract commitment.

decision: Design = editable educator-level decisions + derived content rebuilt by a pure function
why: Guarantees that teacher revisions propagate to prompts, challenges, criteria and runtime rules.

decision: Look-for keyword evidence with minimum-length, reasoning-under-stretch and refutation checks
why: A deterministic, explainable substitute for model judgment. Look-fors are shown to and editable by the educator. Known limitation: paraphrases without look-for words are missed, and keyword stuffing is only partly mitigated.

decision: Test mode (PRIMER_TEST_MODE=1) forces every approval to be recorded as a synthetic TEST approval
why: Synthetic testers can exercise the approval gate without ever producing a classroom approval.

decision: File-based JSON storage with atomic writes and per-record locks
why: Zero dependencies and crash-safe; enough for single-instance classroom pilots.
reversible: Yes: Store is a small interface

decision: The paper's full text was not supplied; the Contract is derived from the build prompt plus the reference repository's whitepaper diagrams and architecture docs
why: Only the build prompt PDF was available; the paper URL is blocked by the network policy.
reversible: Re-check against the paper when it is available
